briefings.title: The unstoppable green revolution: Adam Tooze on the "most dramatic story in the history of energy”

people.name: Adam Tooze
people.role: Director of the European Institute, Columbia University

briefings.tldr: Despite geopolitical conflict and political pushback, the green energy transition is unstoppable, driven by plunging costs of Chinese renewables hardware that offer emerging economies a viable alternative to imported fossil fuels.

briefings.title: Solving the Hardest Problem in Robotics | World Labs with a16z

people.name: Yunzhu Li
people.role: Co-founder, SceniX and Assistant Professor, Columbia University

briefings.tldr: World Labs acquired SceniX to build a real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that combines World Labs' generative world models with SceniX's simulation and robotics stack, tackling the fundamental robotics bottlenecks of data scarcity and offline evaluation.

briefings.title: Why Scale Will Not Solve AGI | Vishal Misra - The a16z Show
briefings.tldr: While LLMs are mathematically precise Bayesian inference engines, they are limited by their inability to learn continuously (plasticity) and their reliance on correlation over causation; true AGI requires a shift from pattern matching (Shannon entropy) to causal simulation (Kolmogorov complexity).
